At 00:01 <Subject 1> steps down from the cab step onto the cobbles, plants the stick and limps two steps toward the arch on it, while <Subject 2> walks at a normal pace ahead of him in under the arch, and the step continues to the last frame of the shot. At 00:04 <Subject 2> steps back through the door ahead of him, and the step continues to the last frame of the shot.
